name: Countdown flip clock
what: A split-flap clock counting down 3-2-1 (from 3, 4 or 5) above your head: two cards pop in, the digit flips once a second (the top flap falls, the new bottom lands with a small bounce), it floats gently, then shrinks away. The Editor pins it above the face and keeps it off the face.
origin: MotionLab's own build of a common in-shot effect for talking-head videos: a 3-2-1 flip clock above the speaker’s head (2026-10-27)
min_why: every number shows for tick frames, the last one at least half a second, then the clock leaves (11 f)
motion: f0-f11 the two cards pop in (0.7 to 1, decelerating with an overshoot, the left one 2 f first); at f(k x tick) the digit flips (k = 1 .. count_from - 1, tick 30 by default): the old top flap falls 4.5 f (accelerating), the new bottom flap lands 4.5 f with a small bounce; from f10 it floats +-3 px (60 f); the last 11 f both cards shrink to 0.8 and fade (accelerating, the right one first)
